newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tricom Holdings share trading suspended.
newsitem.headline: Tricom Holdings share trading suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Tricom Holdings Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the stock exchange said on Monday.
Shares of the telecommunications concern fell one cent to close at HK$0.77 a share on Friday on volume of 40,000 shares.

Earlier this month, the company said its 67.89 percent controlling shareholders were considering selling down their stake in the company to raise the public shareholding to the stock exchange prescribed minimum 25 percent level.

Tricom had said the public shareholding fell to 21.08 percent from 32.1 percent after Rockie Investment Co Ltd bought 2.52 million shares, which raised its stake in the company to 11.03 percent from 9.9 percent.
Rockie Investment is controlled by Joseph Tsui, a former director of Tricom.
